evidence.notes: Non-pronominal asseoir is transitive (asseoir quelqu'un = to seat someone); pronominal s'asseoir is intransitive (to sit down), as the usage note states.
The person accompanied is a direct object (accompagner quelqu'un), as noted in the usage note.
Takes a direct object in all listed senses: accorder quelque chose (grant), accorder un instrument (tune), accorder les mots (make agree).
accueillir quelqu'un is a direct-object construction (to welcome/receive someone).
Takes a direct object or a que-clause: affirmer quelque chose / affirmer que…, per the usage note.
